(One More Time) |series=Yellow |colorscheme=Yellow}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=The Kindest Tentacruel |title_ja=VS ドククラゲ |title_ro=VS Dokukurage |image=PS058.png |scheme=Yellow |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 58 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|5}} |pub2=VIZ Media monthly issue |pub2-data=Chapter 18 in [[Evolution Action]] |pub3=VIZ Media full volume |pub3-data=Adventure 58 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|5}} |location={{DL|Vermilion City|Port|Vermilion Harbor}} }} '''The Kindest Tentacruel''' (Japanese: '''VS ドククラゲ''' ''VS {{tt|Dokukurage|Tentacruel}}'') is the 58th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 18th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} In [[Vermilion City]], the [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]] learns that {{Adv|Red}} is missing, and hastily tells {{Adv|Yellow}} of the legend of the Legendary Stones of Vermilion Harbor: "Some people think that down there in the ocean by Vermilion Harbor there are four [[Evolution stone]]s that never disappear when used to make a Pokémon evolve: the Legendary [[Fire Stone]], the Legendary [[Water Stone]], the Legendary [[Thunder Stone|Thunderstone]], and the Legendary [[Leaf Stone]]. Now, people had laughed at that legend... until Red's adventure brought him to Vermilion City. His [[Poli]]whirl was thrown into the ocean, but evolved quite suddenly into a {{p|Poliwrath}}! And Poliwhirl only evolve with the Water Stone. Yellow wants to go find the Legendary Stones, much to the annoyance of the [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]] — "They're supposed to be in a heavily guarded sanctuary! You can't just '''waltz''' in there!" But Yellow starts his search for the Legendary Stones anyway. On the ocean surface, Yellow floats on a large mass of [[Kitty]]'s thread, with {{DL|Yellow (Adventures)|Omny}} in the {{i|Poké Ball}} on Yellow's fishing rod, trying to find a Pokémon that can dive down into the wide ocean. But all there are {{p|Tentacool}}! Suddenly, there's a tug on the line... from a giant {{p|Tentacruel}}! It pulls Yellow and his Pokémon down under the ocean. Still holding his breath, Yellow sees a baby Tentacool with a tentacle stuck under a boulder! Yellow hastily sends out {{DL|Yellow (Adventures)|Gravvy}} and it lifts the boulder. But right then, Yellow has to open his mouth, and faints. He awakens still underwater, but able to breathe! He wonders if he is dead, but then sees the baby Tentacool and the Tentacruel and is happy for them. But that's not the most of this adventure — there are the Legendary Stones of Vermilion Harbor! The Legendary ''Stone'' of Vermilion Harbor. Only the [[Leaf Stone]] is there! It looks like the three other Stones... were taken! When Yellow has returned to Vermilion City, he tells the Pokémon Fan Club Chairman the bad news, instantly sealing the Chairman into a pout. Yellow, meanwhile, wonders who took them, thinking that they must have had {{t|Fire}}, {{t|Electric}}, and {{t|Water}} Pokémon they wanted to evolve, because there is no one Pokémon who could evolve with all of those Stones. But then Yellow remembers {{p|Eevee}}, a Pokémon who can evolve with any of those three Stones, and that Red had an Eevee, so Yellow can't help but wonder if Red stole those Legendary Stones. ==Major events== * {{adv|Yellow}} is told about the legend of the {{DL|Vermilion City|Port|Vermilion Harbor}} by the [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} (flashback) * {{adv|Yellow}} * [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Poliwrath}} ([[Poli]]; {{adv|Red}}'s, flashback) * {{p|Eevee}} ([[Vee]]; {{adv|Red}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Graveler}} (Gravvy; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Omanyte}} ([[Omny]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Caterpie}} ([[Kitty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Tentacool}} (multiple) * {{p|Tentacruel}} * {{p|Eevee}} (fantasy) * {{p|Vaporeon}} (fantasy) * {{p|Jolteon}} (fantasy) * {{p|Flareon}} (fantasy) * {{p|Pikachu}} (fantasy) * {{p|Ponyta}} (fantasy) * {{p|Staryu}} (fantasy) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * When {{adv|Yellow}} fantasizes about the Pokémon that can evolve via [[Evolution stone]]s, a {{p|Ponyta}} is seen, but they do not evolve with the use of an Evolution stone. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 毒刺水母|VS Tentacruel}} |cs=Vs.
